description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractSerializer' that provides base functionality for request and response serialization and deserialization strategies within a PSR-7 HTTP message context. It includes methods for reading lines from a stream, splitting headers from the message body, and serializing headers, along with constants for line endings.

classes.name: AbstractSerializer
classes.description: Provides base functionality for serializing and deserializing HTTP message components, including reading lines from streams, splitting headers, and serializing headers.

methods.name: getLine
methods.description: Retrieves a single line from the stream, handling CRLF sequences and throwing exceptions on unexpected characters.

methods.name: splitStream
methods.description: Splits a stream into headers and body content, returning headers as an array and the body as a StreamInterface.

methods.name: serializeHeaders
methods.description: Converts headers array into a string representation suitable for HTTP message serialization.

methods.name: filterHeader
methods.description: Formats a header name into word case per HTTP standards.
